scripts.build:android: expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a --no-daemon --console=plain
scripts.build:ios: expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/RemoteComposeExpo.xcworkspace -scheme RemoteComposeExpo -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
